12/S0.subgoal: Outline the structure of the lecture, focusing on continued evaluation techniques and mitigation strategies.

12/S1.subgoal: List and describe the various types of inputs (e.g., questionnaire-based, physiological) used in evaluating cybersickness.

12/S2.subgoal: Describe the characteristics and applications of interpretable machine learning models in measuring cybersickness.

12/S3.subgoal: Explain the characteristics, functions, and drawbacks of black box models used in cybersickness research.

12/S4.subgoal: Describe how hybrid models combine the strengths of transparent and black box models for evaluation.

12/S5.subgoal: Differentiate between the methodologies of detecting and predicting cybersickness based on measurement events.

12/S6.subgoal: Explain the different types of outputs, such as class labels and sickness scores, generated by evaluation models.

12/S7.subgoal: Introduce mitigation strategies and explore developer-side techniques related to Field of View (FOV) adjustments.

12/S8.subgoal: Describe visual and flow manipulation techniques, such as blurring and rest frames, developers can use to reduce cybersickness.

12/S9.subgoal: Explain hardware modifications and locomotion techniques developers can implement to minimize the effects of cybersickness.

12/S10.subgoal: Recommend lifestyle and behavioral countermeasures users can adopt to minimize personal susceptibility to cybersickness.

12/S11.subgoal: Summarize the key components, measurement techniques, and mitigation approaches for cybersickness.
